segments.he: גְּמָ׳ אָמַר אַבָּיֵי: וְצָרִיךְ לְמֵימַר בְּיוֹם פְּלוֹנִי, וּבְשָׁעָה פְּלוֹנִית, וּבְמָקוֹם פְּלוֹנִי. דִּילְמָא אִיכָּא דְּיָדַעי וְאָתֵי וּמַזֵּים לְהוּ.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» «Abaye says: And» the crier «must» also publicly «proclaim» that the transgression was committed «on such and such a day, at such and such an hour, and at such and such a place,» as «perhaps there are those who know» that the witnesses could not have been in that place at that time, «and they will come» forward «and render» the witnesses «conspiring witnesses.»
